name: Feather, Radiant Arbiter
oracle_text:
Flying, lifelink
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell that targets only Feather, you may choose any number of other creatures that spell could target and pay {2} for each of those creatures. If you do, for each of those creatures, copy that spell. The copy targets that creature. (Copies of permanent spells become tokens.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell that targets only Feather, you may choose any number of other creatures that spell could target and pay {2} for each of those creatures. If you do, for each of those creatures, copy that spell. The copy targets that creature.

needs.what: a spell_cast trigger filter matching a spell you cast (here noncreature) whose every target is this permanent, with the spell bound as the trigger's subject
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spell_cast's trigger_filter_keys read the spell's own characteristics (types, not_types, colors, mana_value), not its targets; becomes_target with targeted_by fires when this creature is one target among several and on copies too, so it cannot say 'cast ... that targets only Feather'

needs.what: an op that lets the controller choose any number of other creatures the triggering spell could legally target, pay {2} per chosen creature, and then create one copy of that spell per chosen creature with each copy's single target fixed to that creature (permanent-spell copies becoming tokens) -- the Mirrorwing Dragon / Zada / Precursor Golem pattern with a per-object price
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_spell takes amount, controller and new_targets, but new_targets lets the copier re-choose targets freely rather than binding each copy to a distinct pre-chosen object; may.pay carries a fixed price, not one scaled by a chosen count of legal targets; and for_each cannot pass its loop object into a copy's target
